seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Strongsville, Ohio for 2026: Christmas in the Village, Breakfast with Santa at Encore Event Center, Santa photos at SouthPark Mall and the Berea Jack Frost Festival of Lights.
seo_description: Christmas events for kids in Strongsville, Ohio for 2026: 4 family events, 2 free, with dates, times and addresses checked on each host's site.
intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Strongsville for 2026, and here is what he found: 4 family events, 2 of them free, including one in neighboring Berea. The magic runs from November 26 (Photos with Santa at SouthPark Mall) through December 24 (Photos with Santa at SouthPark Mall). We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Strongsville

  • 4 Christmas events for kids in Strongsville and neighboring Berea
  • 2 free events: Christmas in the Village at the Strongsville Historical Village and the Jack Frost Festival of Lights in Berea
  • Meet Santa: Santa at Christmas in the Village (December 5 and 6), Breakfast with Santa (December 13), SouthPark Mall (through December 24) and after the Light Up Berea parade (December 5)
  • Parades and tree lightings: Christmas in the Village decorations (December 5 and 6) and the Light Up Berea parade and tree lighting with fireworks (December 5)
  • Season: November 26 to December 24

Planning a bigger day out? Strongsville families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Cleveland, which covers Playhouse Square, Wild Winter Lights at the Cleveland Zoo, WinterLand and holiday shows at Severance.
lede: Strongsville's Christmas runs from an old-fashioned village weekend to Santa at SouthPark Mall and a December breakfast with Santa.
celebrates: Strongsville celebrates with the Strongsville Historical Society's Christmas in the Village, a free weekend with Santa, model trains and gingerbread houses. Families can also eat breakfast with Santa at Encore Event Center or visit Santa at SouthPark Mall, where a quieter Sensory Santa hour is offered on December 13. The city's Winter Wonderland Lighting Celebration with fireworks was held November 22, before our page opened. Neighboring Berea holds its free Jack Frost Festival of Lights on December 5, with the Light Up Berea parade, the tree lighting and fireworks, and it is listed on this page.
lastyear: We did not find a host recap of Christmas 2025 in Strongsville to quote. The city's event pages show the Winter Wonderland Lighting Celebration with Santa in the gazebo, fireworks and trolley rides as the kickoff, and the recreation center has run Fun and Photos with Santa in past years.
facts: Christmas in the Village at 13305 Pearl Road is free on December 5 and 6, and Encore Event Center sells breakfast tickets for $20 per child and $40 per adult.
trains: Strongsville has a model train display at Christmas in the Village on December 5 and 6.
